meta.what: Words coined for this project and ratified by the owner. Each is new: it occurs in no game text and no official source.
meta.label: Every word here is shown in the app as invented, never as the games' own.
meta.source: docs/decisions-log.md records each coinage with the owner's words.

words.use: a separate possessive word before the noun, like ok (his) and ek (her)
words.owner_reasoning: A combination: nii, and then the st from nust, so that it stands with nii, nust and niin.

checks.sound_pattern: begins with n and ends in -st after ii, as kriist does; all attested
checks.note: The pattern behind ok and ek (the pronoun without its first sound) would have given ust. The owner chose niist.

words.said: nist ("neest"), one syllable, by the rule for new words

words.use: a question word; it comes first in the question
built_from: w-, as in wo (who) and wen (whose)
words.coined_by: proposed by the assistant, accepted by the project owner
words.reasoning: The game pairs no question word with its answer word, but many languages do (there and where, then and when). Each word is the game's own answer word with w in front, to sit beside wo and wen.

checks.sound_pattern: one syllable; beginning and ending both common in game words
